reasons.bold: Avoids large confrontations and doesn't seek advancement, but impulsively swims in cold water.
reasons.curious: Constantly observes small details and counts grave markers himself rather than trusting the record.
reasons.patient: Tolerates broken machine for 'week before' and unresolved car insurance for months without pushing back.
reasons.trusting: Doesn't demand explanations or money back; 'better than most conversations' with a stranger.
reasons.thorough: 'always look at the shoes'; notices the seal cracks 'pencil-wide'; counts grave markers himself.
reasons.stubborn: 'stopped correcting people' about his name and accepts setbacks without digging in.
reasons.restless: Same job 30 years, wakes '5:40 without an alarm,' finds satisfaction in small routines.
